relationships.subject: Nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury produced by spinal nerve ligation (SNL) causes a sustained increase in G9a expression and the catalytic product, H3K9me2, in the DRG.

relationships.subject: G9a
relationships.evidence_quote: These studies clearly indicate that G9a plays a major role in epigenetic silencing of a large number of K+ channel genes, which contributes to the increased excitability of DRG neurons and development of chronic neuropathic pain after nerve injury.

relationships.subject: G9a
relationships.evidence_quote: conditional knockout of G9a in DRG neurons restores the expression level of MOR and the analgesic effect of morphine diminished by nerve injury

relationships.subject: REST
relationships.evidence_quote: REST knockdown with siRNA or knockout in DRG neurons restores the expression level of mAChR2 in the injured DRG

relationships.subject: Nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury also enhances EZH2 expression and enrichment of its catalytic product H3K27me3 at the promoter of Kcna4, Kcnd2, Kcnq2, and Kcnma1 in the DRG.

relationships.subject: Pannexin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Increased pannexin-1 activity in the DRG leads to the release of ATP and caspase-1 to cause pain hypersensitivity after nerve injury.

relationships.subject: Nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Also, SNL increases the mRNA and protein levels of HDAC4, but not HDAC5, in the DRG.

relationships.subject: PRMT7
relationships.evidence_quote: PRMT7 interacts with NaV1.9 (Scn11a) in the mouse DRG and methylates the arginine 519 (R519) residue in its hLoop1.

key_findings: Nerve injury-induced G9a/H3K9me2 represses K+ channel, opioid receptor and cannabinoid receptor genes in DRG, driving neuropathic pain.
Review of histone methylation, acetylation, DNA methylation and ncRNA mechanisms in DRG after nerve injury.
